base-branch: Modifier on .branch-control that tests and the new-thread form read; the picker inside is styled by .branch-*.
deliveries: Marker on the delivery-log dialog, which is styled by .dialog and .wide-dialog.
delivery-detail: Wrapper of one delivery; its children (.task-status, .delivery-block) carry the styles.
diff-hunk: Wrapper of one hunk; its header and rows (.diff-hunk-header, .diff-row, .diff-split-row) carry the styles.
git-reason: Screen-reader text beside the primary git action, hidden by .sr-only on the same element.
handoff-divider: Modifier on .system-divider read by tests; the divider is styled by .system-divider.
header-more-backdrop: Marker beside .branch-picker-backdrop on the header overflow menu's click-away layer, which that class styles.
import-group: Wrapper of one group in the import dialog; its rows (.import-row) carry the styles.
limit-recovery: Marker on the limit recovery panel, which is styled by .composer-panel.
pr-list-page: Marker on the pull request list page, which is styled by .settings-page.
provider-arguments: Marker beside .provider-field on the launch arguments row; the rows are styled by .provider-argument-rows.
rewind-error: Marker beside .error-banner on the rewind failure; the banner styles it.
scheduled-tasks-page: Marker on the scheduled tasks page, which is styled by .settings-page.
source-control-page: Marker on the source control page, which is styled by .settings-page.
subagent-group: Wrapper of a group of subagents; the head and members (.subagent-group-head, .subagent-members) carry the styles.
syntax-line: Wrapper of one highlighted line; tokens carry their own inline colour and the line inherits its parent's white-space.
task-editor: Marker on the task editor dialog, which is styled by .dialog and .wide-dialog.
terminal-session-group: Wrapper of one terminal group in the sidebar list; .terminal-group-label and .terminal-session carry the styles.
theme-library: Marker on the theme library section; its heading and rows (.theme-library-heading) carry the styles.
thread-created-card: Modifier on .resource-card read by tests; the card is styled by .resource-card.
tree-file: Modifier on .tree-row that marks a file row apart from a directory row; .tree-row styles both.
unavailable-traits: Modifier on .model-traits for saved options the model no longer offers; .model-traits styles it.
usage-chart: Wrapper of the chart; .usage-chart-body and the plot classes carry the styles.
webhook-endpoint: Wrapper of the webhook address row; .webhook-address carries the styles.
work-member: Wrapper of one call in an expanded work group; the call's own card is styled by .tool-activity.
